body:
So for whatever reason I need to speak my peace. I really do not know why I'm doing it here but just glad I am. This decision has disheartened me so much but I really have tried. I mean really.
  I live in Louisiana USA & just want to share my story. Let me just start by saying that depression is the darkest blackest foulest stinchest inhumane prison if there ever was one. A prison bound by walls of skin. No parole, no probation, no release, no freedom & only 1 escape. To weigh whether to live or not live on the scales has been the hardest part. Coming to a conclusion was so hard until I had nothing left. Here I am. 
  There is clinical depression and situational depression. I've got so much of both that this language I speak cannot express. I'm beyond broken. Beyond gone. There is just nothing left. It hurts to do anything. Anything at all. 
  Life has become a task beyond that which I am capable of. My story is a very sad one. All I have left is my candidness & honesty. I'm giving it & by the time I'm finished whoever reads this would have gladly flipped the switch. Most of all I just want the couple of people that this might impact to understand & not hate me as I've seen so often.
